### policy_conflict_scan
The base YAML mapping is identical for every key to blueprint/products/support.yaml. Full base policy rules and eight extended policies were scanned. The narrow commercial scopes are missing-export underbilling versus paid rate-error surplus disposal. Invoice, meter, correction, cash and service-credit boundaries stay distinct. All negotiated fee fractions take priority over promotions and portfolio reductions; support minimum is applied last. Physical exports are evidence, recognized supported_usd is the posting, and reviewed vcpu_hour is evidence, preventing double posting. Completed arithmetic reviews can authorize corrections; service-credit eligibility is conditional on service_credit subtype and does not prohibit incorrect billing reviews. Source tax is inherited. Lifecycle, ancillary, incident and collection policies impose no additional action on a source correction or refund. The two candidate tree scopes use separate policy IDs; actual claims remain masked until comparison.

### rule_compute_equivalence
Each compute binding has a verbatim compute_basis quotation in its rule (checked all eight policies; no missing quote). Selection by latest review establishes source/period. Active same-customer same-entity compute terms supply only a pretax spending rate. Non-stacked approved rates, absent-contract zero, on-demand configuration, status/subtype/source/period filters, minimum, caps and rounding all have explicit textual bases. The following binding-by-binding record permits checking both directions:

#### support_ext_missing_spend
Target `recognize_support_spend_d501a001.quantity`.
- `source = LATEST('support_events','source_event_id',event_type='support_review',date_field='occurred_at')`; basis: “The latest billing review by occurred_at identifies the precise original source charge and its service period.”
- `period = LATEST('support_events','period',event_type='support_review',date_field='occurred_at')`; basis: “The latest billing review by occurred_at identifies the precise original source charge and its service period.”
- `approved = CFIELD('compute','negotiated_approval',status='active',billing_entity=F('billing_entity')) == 'approved'`; basis: “Select the same-customer active compute contract with the same billing_entity; use its approved negotiated_unit_rate, otherwise its tier unit_rate. If there is no matching compute contract, the reconstructed compute rate is zero and no compute-spend contribution is recognized.”
- `cloud_rate = CFIELD('compute','negotiated_unit_rate',status='active',billing_entity=F('billing_entity')) if approved else (CPARAM('compute','unit_rate',status='active',billing_entity=F('billing_entity')) or 0)`; basis: “Select the same-customer active compute contract with the same billing_entity; use its approved negotiated_unit_rate, otherwise its tier unit_rate. If there is no matching compute contract, the reconstructed compute rate is zero and no compute-spend contribution is recognized.”
- `cloud_discount = 0 if approved else (CPARAM('compute','promotion_discount',status='active',billing_entity=F('billing_entity')) if CFIELD('compute','promotion_status',status='active',billing_entity=F('billing_entity')) == 'eligible' else 0)`; basis: “For these on-demand compute export reconstructions, an approved negotiated rate receives no further discount; otherwise an eligible compute promotion reduces the compute price by that compute tier promotion_discount, and an absent or expired promotion gives zero discount.”
- `effective_cloud_rate = cloud_rate * (1-cloud_discount)`; basis: “Multiply the selected compute unit price once by one minus its applicable compute discount to obtain the effective cloud rate; all source intervals in this reconciliation use us_east and on-demand standard configuration.”
- `missing_hours = SUM('support_events','quantity',event_type='support_service_record',status='completed',source_subtype='primary',source_event_id=source,period=period)`; basis: “Sum completed primary support spending export quantity in vcpu_hour for the selected original charge and period; rejected exports and supplemental baseline exports are excluded.”
- `spend = missing_hours*effective_cloud_rate`; basis: “Multiply missing exported vCPU-hours by the effective cloud rate to obtain missing eligible supported_usd spending.”
- `result = int(MX(0,spend)*1000000+0.5)/1000000`; basis: “Floor missing eligible spending at zero, then round only the resulting supported_usd quantity half up to six decimal places.”

- `cloud_rate = CFIELD('compute','negotiated_unit_rate',status='active',billing_entity=F('billing_entity')) if approved else (CPARAM('compute','unit_rate',status='active',billing_entity=F('billing_entity')) or 0)`; basis: “Select the same-customer active compute contract with the same billing_entity; use its approved negotiated_unit_rate, otherwise its tier unit_rate. If there is no matching compute contract, the reconstructed compute rate is zero and no compute-spend contribution is recognized.”
- `cloud_discount = 0 if approved else (CPARAM('compute','promotion_discount',status='active',billing_entity=F('billing_entity')) if CFIELD('compute','promotion_status',status='active',billing_entity=F('billing_entity')) == 'eligible' else 0)`; basis: “For these on-demand compute export reconstructions, an approved negotiated rate receives no further discount; otherwise an eligible compute promotion reduces the compute price by that compute tier promotion_discount, and an absent or expired promotion gives zero discount.”
- `effective_cloud_rate = cloud_rate * (1-cloud_discount)`; basis: “Multiply the selected compute unit price once by one minus its applicable compute discount to obtain the effective cloud rate; all source intervals in this reconciliation use us_east and on-demand standard configuration.”
- `recognized = SUM('support_events','quantity',event_type='support_meter',status='posted',source_subtype='primary',source_event_id=source,period=period)`; basis: “Sum posted primary support_meter quantity for the exact original source charge and service period; reversed or unrelated periods are excluded.”
- `baseline_hours = SUM('support_events','quantity',event_type='support_service_record',status='completed',source_subtype='supplemental',source_event_id=source,period=period)`; basis: “Sum completed supplemental support spending export quantity, in vcpu_hour, for the same original charge and period; primary missing-export records and rejected records do not enter this baseline.”
- `support_rate = F('negotiated_unit_rate') if F('negotiated_approval') == 'approved' else P('unit_rate')`; basis: “Use the support contract approved negotiated fee fraction when present, otherwise its tier unit_rate.”
- `support_discount = 0 if F('negotiated_approval') == 'approved' else (P('promotion_discount') if F('promotion_status') == 'eligible' else 0)`; basis: “An approved negotiated support fraction takes no additional discount regardless of portfolio spending; otherwise, within the on-demand reconciliation branch without an applicable portfolio discount, apply eligible support promotion_discount, or zero for an absent or expired promotion.”
- `minimum = P('minimum_monthly_fee')`; basis: “The full-month support minimum_monthly_fee remains the last floor after applying the support fee fraction and its single selected discount.”

- `fee = MX(minimum,eligible_spend*support_rate*(1-support_discount))`; basis: “Multiply eligible spending by the support fee fraction and then by one minus the single support discount; apply the full-month minimum to that discounted subtotal.”
- `result = int(fee*100+0.5)/100`; basis: “Round the resulting nonnegative reviewed net support fee half up to two decimal places; the selected source tax treatment is us_untaxed and reviewed tax_amount is zero.”

- `principal = -SUM('support_events','amount',event_type='support_payment',status='posted',support_event_id=payment)-SUM('support_events','amount',event_type='support_payment_return',status='posted',source_event_id=payment)-SUM('support_events','amount',event_type='support_refund',status='posted',source_event_id=payment)`; basis: “Available original principal is the magnitude of the selected posted payment minus posted returns and refunds linked to that exact payment, with other payments excluded.”
- `retained_surplus = MX(0,-receivable-corrected_fee)`; basis: “When the customer elects to retain one corrected source-month support fee as account funding, subtract that corrected fee from the magnitude of the negative current receivable, then floor the refundable surplus at zero; this is a customer funding choice and not an additional charge.”
- `candidate = MN(retained_surplus,MX(0,principal))`; basis: “The selected refund request cannot exceed either the surplus after retained funding or the nonnegative remaining original payment principal.”
- `result = int(candidate*100+0.5)/100 if candidate >= P('refund_minimum') else 0`; basis: “A candidate at least refund_minimum is rounded half up to cents; a smaller candidate remains on account and produces no refund authorization or financial write.”
